scripts.check:freshness: npm run clean:freshness && tsgo -p tsconfig.json --outDir .freshness-dist && node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; const generated = '.freshness-dist'; const published = 'public/js'; const jsFiles = (directory) => readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).filter((entry) => entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.js')).map((entry) => entry.name).sort(); try { const expected = jsFiles(generated); const actual = jsFiles(published); const namesMatch = expected.length === actual.length && expected.every((name, index) => name === actual[index]); const stale = namesMatch ? expected.filter((name) => !readFileSync(generated + '/' + name).equals(readFileSync(published + '/' + name))) : []; if (!namesMatch || stale.length > 0) { console.error('public/js is stale. Run npm run build.'); if (!namesMatch) console.error('Expected:', expected.join(', '), '\nActual:', actual.join(', ')); if (stale.length > 0) console.error('Changed:', stale.join(', ')); process.exitCode = 1; } else { console.log('public/js is fresh.'); } } finally { rmSync(generated, { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
